retrievalProfile.description: A dense, surrealist hand-drawn illustration featuring a mix of human figures and grotesque creatures on a beach, topped with vibrant psychedelic bubble lettering on a banner.
excludeWhen: modern digital vector styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic, multi-character scene set on a yellow beach under a cyan sky, rendered with visible colored pencil hatching and ink outlines. The composition is anchored by a white curved banner containing two distinct styles of hand-drawn display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Dense character cluster against a simplified beach horizon
Vibrant, multi-colored lettering contrasting with a white banner
Rough, textured pencil shading against flat sky color
Juxtaposition of realistic human portraits and fantastical monsters
coreInvariants: Visible colored pencil cross-hatching and texture
Heavy black ink outlines for all figures
Curved white banner separating the sky from the main scene

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A crowded group of figures occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white banner in the upper third acts as the primary focal point for information.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold lettering on the banner, then move downward into the dense, chaotic character details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the flat cyan sky at the top and small patches of sand.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and lettering; varied values and textures in the character group.

letterConstructionRules: Top row: Cloud-like, bumpy outlines with white fill
Bottom row: Liquid, psychedelic bubble forms with multi-colored fills and thick black outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title feature internal color gradients or solid fills that change per character
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between 'cloud-textured' white lettering and 'liquid-melt' multi-colored lettering.
graphicDevices: Small bird-like creatures holding the banner ends

candidateDirections.reason: Approximate weight and rounded feel for the bubble forms

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dense, hand-drawn illustration in colored pencil and ink of a surreal beach party with humans and monsters. Leave the top third for a cyan sky and a large, empty white curved banner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn psychedelic bubble lettering inside the banner, using multi-colored fills and thick black outlines for the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering hand-drawn and irregular?
Does the illustration show visible pencil hatching?
Is the banner curved and centered in the upper third?
Are the characters a mix of humans and surreal creatures?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly horizontal
Verify colored pencil texture is visible in the shading
Check that the banner is the primary visual anchor
Confirm the presence of thick black ink outlines
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dense surrealist character illustration with a 1960s psychedelic banner and liquid-bubble hand-lettering.
